item.title: Academic seminar: Introduction to Programming with Python
item.description: Winter semester 2026–27: every Friday, 09:30–11:00, in Room A of the Computer Laboratory, Department of Mathematics.
item.content:encoded: The academic seminar “Introduction to Programming with Python” will be held during the winter semester of the 2026–27 academic year. Meetings will take place every Friday, from 09:30 to 11:00, in Room A of the Computer Laboratory, Department of Mathematics. Seminar materials are posted on the eClass platform: https://eclass.uoa.gr/courses/MATH926/ Seminar page
